title: Determinants of Banking Profitability: The Impact of Internal and Macroeconomic Factors
core_idea: Empirically examine which internal bank characteristics and macroeconomic variables are associated with bank profitability (ROA) in Kosovo over 2016–2024 using quarterly panel data and panel regression models, with fixed effects to control for unobserved bank-level heterogeneity.
tldr: Analyzes how internal bank factors and macroeconomic conditions relate to banks' return on assets in Kosovo (2016–2024) using fixed-effects panel regression on quarterly data.
